# Team brief: Linkshelf attachments and text alerts

## Problem

Users attach a PDF or image of up to 20 MB to a saved link, and can opt in to a text message when their weekly digest is ready.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): a signed-in user can attach one file of up to 20 MB to a link and download it later.
- AC-2 (draft): a user who opted in receives a text message when the digest is sent.

## Constraints

- TypeScript on Bun, one long-running server, one person operating it.

## What exists

New project.

## Questions for each specialist

- infra: where attached files are stored and how text messages are sent.

# Team brief: password reset by email

## Problem

Users who forget their password have no way back in. Add a reset flow that emails a single-use link.

## Draft acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (draft): requesting a reset for a known email sends one message containing a single-use link.
- AC-2 (draft): the link sets a new password once and then stops working.

## Constraints

- Keep the existing database, sessions, hosting, and CI.

## What exists

The pilot repository.

## Questions for each specialist

- infra: how email is sent, and what the owner must set up.

architecture.md.inline:
# Architecture: password reset by email

Task: eval-infra-03
Author: architect

## Decision

The reset flow is added to the existing auth module. Email leaves the process through a new mailer port with a fake for tests and the preview. No new deployable.

## Options considered

None beyond the existing structure.

## Rationale

The change is contained in auth and one new adapter.

## Curated entries used

- `ports-and-adapters` (pattern, architecture): the mailer port and its fake.

## Catalog gaps

None.

## Assumptions

None.
